claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Deferiprone is an iron chelator that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its pharmacological action is to prevent iron-dependent lipid peroxidation (ferroptosis) rather than to kill cancer cells.
